function.name: open_app
function.description: Open an installed application by its name, e.g. 'Spotify', 'Calculator', 'Google Chrome'.

name.description: Application name as the user said it.

function.name: close_app
function.description: Close a running application by its name. Asks the user for confirmation.

name.description: Application name as the user said it.

function.name: set_volume
function.description: Change the master volume. Pass exactly ONE of: level (set to a percentage), delta (raise or lower by a number of points) or mute (mute or unmute).

mute.description: true to mute, false to unmute.

function.name: web_search
function.description: Search the web for information and get a short summary of the results.

function.name: power_action
function.description: Lock, sleep, restart or shut down the PC. Asks the user for confirmation.

function.name: create_reminder
function.description: Create a reminder. Give a delay_minutes (relative) OR an at_local_time (absolute). Do not compute dates yourself.

text.description: What to remind the user of.

delay_minutes.description: Minutes from now, for relative requests ('in 20 minutes').

at_local_time.description: Local time of day, 24-hour HH:MM, for absolute requests ('at 9 pm' -> '21:00').

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD, only if the user said an explicit calendar date.
